mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t_auth_credentials ( user_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, password_hash VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.select: SELECT password_hash FROM t_auth_credentials WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_credentials(user_id,password_hash,updated_at) VALUES (#{userId},#{hash},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE password_hash=#{hash},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
